ref.description: the id of the labelled item it points to

value.description: null for a yes/no assumption such as 'you pay in full'

coverage.description: measured P10-P90 coverage: for the 'why trust this' sheet only, never next to a prediction

reason.description: shown next to the label, e.g. 'band held on 64% of past days, target 80%'

series.description: paise, end of day; negative = shortfall

snapshot_id.description: set when ?wait=true and the recompute finished

what_if.description: a conditional prediction: a what-if the user asked about or one Hisaab offers to explore (D10); `text` states its condition

display.description: pre-formatted; the app never formats money itself
display.title: Display

value.description: paise (int) for money, percent units for pct, ISO date for date
value.title: Value

text.description: the action, its simulated impact and its assumptions, in the chosen language

what_if_offers.title: What If Offers

info.description:
Hisaab: AI Financial Health Copilot, API v1.

Every number is labelled FACT, PREDICTION (with confidence) or RECOMMENDATION (with its simulated impact and
assumptions). A what-if the user asks about is a conditional PREDICTION. Money is a Quantity: integer paise plus a
display string. **Auth is dev-only** (`X-User-Id`).
info.title: Hisaab API
